terms.retention_quote: Automatic Expiration: Cached data is ephemeral. We guarantee a Time-To-Live (TTL) of 5 minutes, though caches may persist up to 1 hour depending on system load.
terms.zdr_quote: Is prompt caching secure? Yes, it is fully ZDR-compliant. All cached context remains ephemeral in memory and never persisted. Cached tokens are stored in key-value stores colocated in the same data center as the model instance serving your traffic.
